Artificial Intelligence (AI) Products and Services
Atos Governmental IT Outsourcing Services. LLC. is honored to provide Artificial
Intelligence (AI) Products and Services to State, Local Government. Higher
Education and other public entities under the Texas Department of Information
Resources (DIR) Cloud Solutions contract.
Reference the Contract# DIR-CPO-5133 on your purchase order
Contracts:
Pam Kunhart
(916) 425-3739
Texas DIR Cloud Services Contract Overview
The mission of the Texas Department of Information Resources is to serve Texas government by leading the state’s technology strategy, protecting state technology infrastructure, and offering innovative and cost- effective solutions for all levels of government.
The Artificial Intelligence (AI) Products and Services will provide DIR Customers with access to services for Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision (CV), and Digital Assignment (DA).
Reach out to the Point of Contact for quotes and placing Purchase Orders.
